Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: broaden.

**What the vignettes add.** The record centres on the first open and the top level. Vignettes add a broader readability claim: "A human using srs must be able to have a view that makes sense" (fd67e965), "Right now human readability has been lagging behind" (7436c396, 2026-10-30), with "Readability by humans and AI with intact semantics" called the core offering. Owner's own comprehension failure: "I cannot understand them at all" (29eca855). Navigation should be a useful tree (baee7d9a), start with a top-level introduction and drill down (62c4c942), stay stable once settled and evolve consistently, with only significant redesigns for PR; muSrs has no working structure so any change is an improvement (ac5974c6, 2026-10-27). It also asks for experiments to find which ways make repositories readable by default (751f232e, 33e22c92).

**Proposed.** A person opening a repository cannot understand it: the top level is a dump of records, not a few areas with an introduction to drill down from, and human readability lags behind the promise of readable meaning for humans and AI. I need a tree that makes sense on first view, stays stable once settled and grows consistently.

**Depth.** Moderate: 10 vignettes, 2026-10-27 to 2026-11, recurring and tied to the core-offering purpose.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
